changes.name: cheap-adjoint |STFT| in the MR-STFT loss
changes.mechanism: custom autograd Function: forward torch.stft + magnitude from the real view; backward = analytic d|z|/dz (g*z/|z|) -> rfft adjoint -> *window -> F.fold -> reflect-pad adjoint. The ~480 ms aten::stft backward is never executed.

changes.name: packed band-split / mask-head bmm
changes.measured_isolated: 62 per-band GEMMs 0.2977 ms -> one padded bmm 0.0297 ms (10.0x) at bs1; not adopted because at bs24 the whole band_split GEMM group is a small part of the 202 ms forward and the padding wastes 2.0x FLOPs

changes.verdict: graph API works (simple MLP replay 0.023 ms, bit-exact) but the U-Net forward fails to capture: endCaptureErr 107025 (cross-stream) for both capture modes; BandSplit and enc62 capture individually. Even if it captured, the bs24 step is not launch bound: 1910 kernels x 4.47 us = 8.54 ms of a 1987 ms step (0.4%).

floors.istft_fwd_floor_ms: 83 ms per istft call (vendor FFT), unavoidable without fusing istft into the loss
floors.mrstft_adjoint_floor_ms: ~120 ms for 3 resolutions: each does one torch.stft recompute (13-30 ms) + rfft adjoint (16 ms) + fold (3 ms); saving the spectrum in forward would remove one of the two FFT passes (~100-150 ms total)
floors.model_fwd_bwd_floor_ms: 4500 GFLOP fwd at the measured 202 ms = 22 TFLOPS (5.9% of peak); the 62-band Linear group and the depthwise convs are the reason, and both need kernel fusion (not attempted here)

what_6x_would_need.primary_source: the model forward+backward (763 ms) and the istft/SI-SDR graph (469 ms) were not attacked: only the STFT loss was. Fusion work for the 62-band linears, depthwise convs and the istft path is required to go below ~1.5 s.

would_change_recipe: computing the MR-STFT loss directly on the model spectrum instead of istft->stft

alignment.note: the model, the loss formula and the data pipeline are unchanged; only the adjoint implementation of |STFT| differs, verified at gradient level to <= 7e-07
